plain: The running of a government or group; also the officials who run it.

webster.text: The act of administering; direction; management; government of public affairs; the conducting of any office or employment.

example.quote: In brief, a part of these colonies now feel, and all of them are sure of feeling, as far as the vengeance of administration can inflict them, the complicated calamities of fire, sword and famine.
example.cite: Declaration of the Causes and Necessity of Taking Up Arms, July 6, 1775
